report_comment.text: PAX3 encodes a paired-box transcription factor involved in development. FOXO1 encodes a forkhead-family transcription factor. PAX3::FOXO1 is a recurrent fusion in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma. In the CWS alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma cohort, PAX3::FOXO1 was associated with inferior outcomes, including an independent adverse association with event-free survival in localized disease.
